verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Holy darkness, blessed night
Heaven's answer hidden from our sight

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
As we await you
O God of silence
We embrace your holy night

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I have tried you in fires of affliction
I have taught your soul to grieve

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
In the barren sould of your loneliness
There I will plant my seed

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I have taught you the price of compassion
You have stood before the grave

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Though my love can seem like a raging storm
This is the love that saves

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Were you there when I raised up the mountains?
Can you guide the morning star?

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Does the hawk take flight when you give command?
Why do you doubt my power?
